# apps/web/src/types/expense.ts

**Purpose:** Types for expenses and their splits.

**Key contents:** `SplitType` (EQUAL, UNEQUAL, PERCENTAGE), `Expense`, `ExpenseSplit`, create/update payloads, `ListExpensesParams`.

**Depends on / used by:** `lib/api/expenses.ts`, `lib/balances.ts`.

**Decisions & caveats:** Amounts may be `number | string` since the API returns Decimal strings. `deleted_at` means soft-deleted. `recurring_expense_id` links expenses generated by recurring sync. A personal expense has `group_id` null and a single 100% split.
